slices.focus: Fall checkup confirms blood pressure manageable without medication; doctor advises maintaining current routine through winter.
slices.summary: Nathaniel's fall checkup shows blood pressure remaining in a manageable range without medication. The doctor credits steady walking, less sodium, and fewer drive-through meals. Nathaniel plans a simple winter version of his routine to avoid backsliding: shorter walks, indoor backup, repeat meal list.
